title: 깜짝 파티
scene: 유진 생일. 몰래 파티를 준비하는데 유진이 한 시간 일찍 도착한다
goal: A surprise party where everything goes wrong

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: (속삭이며) 민준아, 풍선 아직도 다 안 불었잖아. 유진이 7시쯤 온다며, 지금 이 속도면 절대 안 돼.
turns.rd: (soksagimyeo) minjuna, pungseon ajikdo da an bureotjana. yujini 7sijjeum ondamyeo, jigeum i sokdomyeon jeoldae an dwae.
turns.en: Minjun, the balloons still aren't all blown up. Yujin said she's coming around 7, there's no way we'll make it at this pace.

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: 지금 막 6시 넘었거든. 케이크는 냉장고에 잘 넣어뒀으니까 그거만 신경 쓰지 마.
turns.rd: jigeum mak 6si neomeotgeodeun. keikeuneun naengjanggoe jal neoeodwosseunikka geugeoman singyeong sseuji ma.
turns.en: It's just past 6. The cake's safely in the fridge, so don't worry about that.

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 좋아. 그럼 불만 끄고 저쪽 커튼 뒤에 숨어 있으면 되는 거지? 소리 내지 말고.
turns.rd: joa. geureom bulman kkeugo jeojjok keoteun dwie sumeo isseumyeon doeneun geoji? sori naeji malgo.
turns.en: Okay. So we just turn the lights off and hide behind that curtain, right? No noise.

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: (문 열리며) 어? 나 왔어~ 일 생각보다 일찍 끝나서 바로 왔지.
turns.rd: (mun yeollimyeo) eo? na wasseo~ il saenggakboda iljjik kkeunnaseo baro watji.
turns.en: Huh? I'm here~ Work finished earlier than I thought so I came straight over.

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 헐… 잠깐만! 들어오지 마, 그냥 거기서 잠깐만 기다려!
turns.rd: heol… jamkkanman! deureooji ma, geunyang geogiseo jamkkanman gidaryeo!
turns.en: Whoa… wait! Don't come in, just wait there for a sec!

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 왜 그래? 무슨 소리야 이게? (펑! 펑! 또 펑!) 뭐가 계속 터지는데?
turns.rd: wae geurae? museun soriya ige? (peong! peong! tto peong!) mwoga gyesok teojineunde?
turns.en: Why? What's that sound? (pop! pop! another pop!) What's keep bursting?

turns.speaker: C
turns.en: Ah, a balloon popped! The cake, the cake!

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: …Don't tell me this is all for me?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Ugh… it was a surprise and it's all ruined.

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 망하긴. 케이크 위에 크림만 좀 찌그러졌네.
turns.rd: manghagin. keikeu wie keurimman jom jjigeureojyeonne.
turns.en: Ruined? Just a little cream got squashed.

turns.speaker: C
turns.en: The candles survived! Quick, the song!

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Happy birthday to you… even though the party's a mess…

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Right. But it's my best birthday.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Really? There's cake on the floor.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yep. That's why I'll remember it.
